principle: Deterministic first -> Embedding similarity -> No LLM (avoid bloat). Use WebFind's existing FastEmbed + whatlang + regex.

layers.name: Deterministic / Rule-Based
layers.coverage: Exact identifiers (CVE, GHSA, E0xxx, RFC), code verbs, known source triggers
layers.implementation: Pre-compiled regex + keyword sets (already in route_intent_code)
layers.output: SourceTier + specific engine hints (e.g., raw_github, nvd, clinicaltrials)

layers.name: Embedding Similarity (FastEmbed)
layers.coverage: Semantic domain routing when no deterministic signal
layers.output: Best-matching domain -> engine subset + SourceTier boost
layers.confidence: cosine similarity; threshold >= 0.75 routes; else fallback

layers.name: Language Detection (whatlang)
layers.coverage: Multilingual queries -> route to language-specific indexes
layers.output: Language code -> boost matching language engines

layers.name: Fallback / General Web
layers.implementation: General web engines (DDG, Bing, Mojeek, Marginalia) with source-precision re-rank
layers.output: General results demoted by source tier

performance_target: < 5ms for 95% of queries (deterministic), < 50ms for embedding fallback
